questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q:
Let $f: R \rightarrow R$ be a continuous function satisfying $f(x)+\int_{0}^{x} t f(t) d t+x^{2}=0$
for all $x \in \mathbb{R}$. Then
options: $f(x)$ has more than one point in common with the $x$-axis
questions.solution:
$f^{\prime}(x)+x f(x)+2 x=0\frac{d y}{d x}+x y=-2 x$
I.F. $=e^{x^{2} / 2}\Rightarrow y \cdot e^{x^{2} / 2}=\int e^{x^{2} / 2}(-2 x) d x+Ce^{x^{2} / 2} \cdot y=-2 e^{x^{2} / 2}+Cy=-2+C e^{i x^{2} / 2}f(0)=0 \Rightarrow C=2f(x)=2  \left[e^{-x^{2} / 2}-1\right]$
